what: ESCI (Amazon Shopping Queries) with human E/S/C/I labels as ground truth: does softavg over title-query cosine find more, and more correct, relevant-vs-overall differences per (query, facet) than AVG, global top-k + AVG, threshold + AVG?
encoder: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (sentence-transformers 4.1.0, torch 2.6.0, /home/jding/bruce/sigmod2027/.venv; the default ~/.local env has a broken torch 2.4 / transformers 5.9 pair)
timing_status: no timings reported except engine_check seconds_smoke (smoke, machine shared)

protocol.split: queries split 50/50 by md5(query_id) into dev/test; every hyperparameter (eps, tau, k, b, d) chosen on dev by findings-F1, reported on test
protocol.bootstrap: 1000 resamples of test queries, paired across estimators
protocol.distractor_rule: random products from the ESCI US catalogue with a rating, same main_category as the query's dominant one, not labelled for the query

coverage.match_rule: ESCI product_id (ASIN) == Amazon Reviews 2023 meta parent_asin
